title: Cell Info Repository: battery-cell specifications as linked data (EMMO / JSON-LD) with a GraphRAG workflow
description:
Specifications of 382 battery cells as linked data. Each cell is a JSON-LD profile typed with the EMMO battery domain ontology (https://w3id.org/emmo/domain/battery/context): rated capacity, voltage limits, currents, cycle life, mass, dimensions, case and cathode chemistry, each value with a citation of its source, plus DOI links to publications that use or reference the cell.

The repository also contains batterygraph, a Python package that loads the profiles into an RDF graph and answers questions about the cells with LLM-generated graph queries (GraphRAG), and a 300-question benchmark with recorded results for three models.
